desktop.notify.description: Shows a pop-up notification on your computer. Cuebot uses the system's notifications where it can (Linux), else its own pop-up in the app.

parameters.title: Optional. The top line, like "New follower!". Default "Cuebot".
parameters.message: The text under the title, like "CoolViewer just followed".
parameters.icon: Optional. The path to an image file to show with it.
parameters.id: Optional. A name for this notification. The "Toast notification clicked" trigger tells you this name when it is clicked.
parameters.duration: Optional. How many seconds it stays on screen, 1 to 120. Default 5.

desktop.notify.returns: Where it was shown: "system" or "in-app". Fails with an error when no way to show it is available.

desktop.setClipboard.description: Puts text on your clipboard, as if you copied it. Fails with an error when this computer has no clipboard Cuebot can use.

parameters.text: The text to copy, like "Thanks for watching!"

desktop.getClipboard.description: Reads the text that is on your clipboard right now. Fails with an error when this computer has no clipboard Cuebot can use.
desktop.getClipboard.returns: The clipboard text, or null when the clipboard holds no text.
